questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'वह दो घंटे से क्रिकेट खेल रहा है।'
options: He has been playing cricket for two hours.
He is playing cricket for two hours.
He plays cricket since two hours.
He had played cricket since two hours.
questions.explanation: निश्चित समय अवधि (two hours) के साथ Present Perfect Continuous का सही अनुवाद 'has been playing... for' होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'पटना एक ऐतिहासिक नगर है।'
options: Patna are historical city.
Patna was a historical city.
Patna is historical city.
Patna is a historical city.
questions.explanation: 'Patna is a historical city' इस वाक्य का सबसे सटीक वर्तमान अनुवाद है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'क्या तुम्हें तैरना आता है?'
options: Do you know how to swim?
Can you swimming?
Are you swim?
Do you know swimming?
questions.explanation: किसी कौशल को जानने के संदर्भ में 'know how to + V1' संरचना का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: 'Honesty always triumphs.'
options: ईमानदार व्यक्ति दुखी रहता है।
सच बोलना बहुत कठिन है।
ईमानदारी कभी नहीं जीतती।
सत्य / ईमानदारी की हमेशा जीत होती है।
questions.explanation: 'Honesty always triumphs' का सही हिंदी अनुवाद 'ईमानदारी की हमेशा विजय होती है' होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'सूर्य के अस्त होने से पहले मैं घर आ गया था।'
options: I had come home before the sun set.
I came home before the sun set.
I came home before the sun had set.
I had come home before the sun was set.
questions.explanation: भूतकाल की दो घटनाओं में पहले होने वाले कार्य के लिए Past Perfect (had come) और बाद वाले के लिए Past Simple (set) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'जैसी करनी वैसी भरनी।'
options: Better late than never.
Do good and have good.
As you sow, so shall you reap.
Work is worship.
questions.explanation: यह एक प्रसिद्ध अंग्रेजी लोकोक्ति (Proverb) है: 'As you sow, so shall you reap.'
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: 'It has been raining cats and dogs since yesterday.'
options: कल थोड़ी बहुत बारिश हुई थी।
कल से मूसलाधार बारिश हो रही है।
कल बिल्ली और कुत्तों पर बारिश हो रही थी।
कल से बारिश बिल्कुल नहीं हो रही है।
questions.explanation: मुहावरे 'raining cats and dogs' का अर्थ मूसलाधार या बहुत तेज़ बारिश होना होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'मुझे गृहकार्य करना है।'
options: I have done my homework.
I must doing my homework.
I had done my homework.
I have to do my homework.
questions.explanation: कोई कार्य करना है (obligation) के संदर्भ में 'have/has + to + V1' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'मनुष्य मरणशील होता है।'
options: Man was mortal.
The man is mortal.
Man is mortal.
Men are mortal.
questions.explanation: 'Man is mortal' एक सार्वभौमिक तथ्य है और इसके पहले किसी आर्टिकल का प्रयोग नहीं होता।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: 'He is slow but steady.'
options: वह बहुत बुद्धिमान और चतुर है।
वह बहुत तेज दौड़ता है।
वह काम नहीं करता है।
वह धीमा है लेकिन निरंतर है (वह काम धीरे करता है पर दृढ़ता से)।
questions.explanation: 'Slow but steady' का अर्थ कार्य में निरंतरता बनाए रखने से है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'is / good / swimming / exercise / a'
options: Exercise is swimming a good.
Swimming exercise is a good.
Swimming is a good exercise.
A good swimming is exercise.
questions.explanation: Gerund (Swimming) को Subject बनाकर वाक्य 'Swimming is a good exercise' बनेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'the / rises / sun / east / in / the'
options: Rises the sun in the east.
The sun rises in the east.
In the east rises the sun.
The east sun rises in the.
questions.explanation: सही क्रम 'Subject + Verb + Prepositional Phrase' (The sun rises in the east) होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'never / tell / lie / a'
options: Never a lie tell.
A lie never tell.
Tell a lie never.
Never tell a lie.
questions.explanation: आज्ञावाचक निषेधात्मक वाक्य (Imperative) होने के कारण 'Never' वाक्य के प्रारंभ में आकर 'Never tell a lie' बनेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'book / is / this / mine'
options: This book is mine.
This is mine book.
Book this is mine.
Mine is book this.
questions.explanation: यहाँ 'This' Demonstrative Adjective है, जो 'book' के पहले आकर 'This book is mine' बनाएगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'you / did / meet / him / yesterday / ?'
options: You did meet him yesterday?
Yesterday did you meet him?
Did yesterday you meet him?
Did you meet him yesterday?
questions.explanation: प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य की संरचना 'Did + Subject + V1 + Object + Time' (Did you meet him yesterday?) होगी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'very / is / she / beautiful / girl / a'
options: A very beautiful girl is she.
She is a very beautiful girl.
She is very beautiful a girl.
She is beautiful a very girl.
questions.explanation: सही विशेषण क्रम 'a + adverb + adjective + noun' (a very beautiful girl) होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'work / hard / pass / to / he / has / to'
options: Work hard he has to to pass.
To pass he has work hard to.
He has to work hard to pass.
He has to pass to work hard.
questions.explanation: सही क्रम है: 'He has to work hard' (obligation) + 'to pass' (purpose)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'honest / man / is / an / Ram'
options: An honest man is Ram.
Ram is an honest man.
Ram is honest an man.
Ram honest is an man.
questions.explanation: सही संरचना 'Subject + is + article + adjective + noun' होगी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'the / teacher / class / is / teaching / in / the'
options: Teaching is the teacher in the class.
In the class the teacher teaching is.
The teacher in the class is teaching.
The teacher is teaching in the class.
questions.explanation: सही संरचना 'Subject + helping verb + main verb + adverbial of place' है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'patient / had / the / died / doctor / the / came / before'
options: Had died the patient before came the doctor.
The patient had died before the doctor came.
Before the doctor came the patient died.
The doctor came before the patient had died.
questions.explanation: यह भूतकाल के दो कार्यों का मानक वाक्य है, जिसमें पहले समाप्त हुए कार्य के लिए Past Perfect (had died) का प्रयोग पहले होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: नकारात्मक (Negative) में बदलें: 'He is always present.'
options: He always is not present.
He is not always present.
He is never absent.
He was not present.
questions.explanation: अर्थ बदले बिना नकारात्मक में बदलने के लिए 'always' को 'never' में और 'present' को उसके विपरीत 'absent' में बदलेंगे।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: प्रश्नवाचक (Interrogative) में बदलें: 'Assertive: Everybody loves his country.'
options: Does everybody love his country?
Everybody does not love his country.
Why everybody loves his country?
Who does not love his country?
questions.explanation: वाक्य का अर्थ समान रखने के लिए 'Everybody loves' को 'Who does not love' में बदला जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: कंपरेटिव डिग्री (Comparative Degree) में बदलें: 'Sita is as wise as Geeta.'
options: Geeta is not wiser than Sita.
Geeta is wiser than Sita.
Sita is wiser than Geeta.
Geeta is as wise as not Sita.
questions.explanation: समानता वाले पॉजिटिव वाक्य को कॉम्परेटिव में बदलने के लिए विपरीत अर्थ का प्रयोग कर 'not wiser than' लिखा जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: विस्मयादिबोधक (Exclamatory) में बदलें: 'It is a very beautiful night.'
options: How beautiful is the night.
A beautiful night it is.
Is it a very beautiful night?
What a beautiful night it is!
questions.explanation: साधारण वाक्य से विस्मयादिबोधक वाक्य बनाने के लिए 'What a / How + Adjective + Subject + Verb!' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: रिमूव 'Too' (Remove Too) करें: 'He is too weak to walk.'
options: He is too weak that he cannot walk.
He is so weak to walk.
He is so weak that he cannot walk.
He is very weak that he cannot walk.
questions.explanation: 'too... to' को हटाने पर 'so... that + Subject + can/could + not + V1' संरचना का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पॉजिटिव डिग्री (Positive Degree) में बदलें: 'Patna is bigger than Gaya.'
options: Gaya is not so big as Patna.
Gaya is as big as Patna.
Patna is as big as Gaya.
Gaya is not bigger than Patna.
questions.explanation: कॉम्परेटिव से पॉजिटिव में बदलते समय वाक्य को नकारात्मक कर 'not so... as' का प्रयोग करते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: साधारण वाक्य (Assertive) में बदलें: 'Interrogative: Can a leopard change his spots?'
options: A leopard can change his spots.
A leopard cannot change his spots.
Leopards do change their spots.
Leopards are not changing spots.
questions.explanation: अलंकारिक प्रश्नों का साधारण वाक्य नकारात्मक होता है क्योंकि उसका उत्तर स्वतः 'नहीं' में छुपा होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: अफेर्मेटिव (Affirmative) में बदलें: 'No sooner did he see the tiger than he fled.'
options: As soon as he saw the tiger, he fled.
He saw the tiger and he fled.
As soon as he had seen the tiger, he fled.
He fled as soon as he see the tiger.
questions.explanation: 'No sooner... than' वाले वाक्यों को सकारात्मक में 'As soon as + Past Simple, Past Simple' में बदलते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सुपरलेटिव डिग्री (Superlative Degree) में बदलें: 'No other metal is as heavy as lead.'
options: Lead is more heavy than all metals.
Lead is heavier than other metals.
Lead is as heavy as all metals.
Lead is the heaviest of all metals.
questions.explanation: 'No other... as... as' संरचना वाले वाक्यों को सुपरलेटिव में 'Subject + is + the + Superlative Adj' द्वारा बदला जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: प्रश्नवाचक में बदलें: 'Assertive: There is no success without hard work.'
options: Can there be success without hard work?
Is there no success with hard work?
Is there success without hard work?
How there is success without hard work?
questions.explanation: वाक्य का अर्थ समान रखने के लिए प्रश्नवाचक रूप 'Can there be success...' होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्यों को जोड़ें (Combine): 'He is poor. He is honest.'
options: He is poor so he is honest.
He is poor but honest.
He is poor because he is honest.
He is poor and honest.
questions.explanation: दो विपरीत गुणों को जोड़ने के लिए कंजंक्शन 'but' का प्रयोग सबसे उपयुक्त है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्यों को जोड़ें: 'The sun rose. The fog disappeared.' (Using Nominative Absolute)
options: The sun rose so the fog disappeared.
As the sun rose, the fog disappeared.
The sun having risen, the fog disappeared.
The sun rose and the fog disappeared.
questions.explanation: जब दो वाक्यों के कर्ता अलग हों और एक कार्य के बाद दूसरा हो, तो 'Subject + having + V3' (Nominative Absolute) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: क्लॉज़ की पहचान करें (Identify Clause): 'I know where he lives.'
options: संज्ञा उपवाक्य | Noun Clause
विशेषण उपवाक्य | Adjective Clause
क्रियाविशेषण उपवाक्य | Adverb Clause
प्रधान उपवाक्य | Principal Clause
questions.explanation: 'where he lives' यहाँ 'know' क्रिया के Object के रूप में कार्य कर रहा है, अतः यह Noun Clause है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्यों को जोड़ें: 'He is very old. He cannot run fast.'
options: He is so old to run fast.
He is old and cannot run fast.
He is too old to run fast.
He cannot run fast because he is old.
questions.explanation: कारण और असमर्थता को दर्शाने के लिए 'too... to' से वाक्यों को संयोजित किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्यों को जोड़ें: 'This is the place. Ram was born here.'
options: This is the place Ram was born here.
Ram was born in this place where.
This is the place there Ram was born.
This is the place where Ram was born.
questions.explanation: स्थान सूचक वाक्यों को जोड़ने के लिए 'where' Adjective Clause का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: क्लॉज़ की पहचान करें: 'The book which is on the table is mine.'
options: संज्ञा उपवाक्य | Noun Clause
विशेषण उपवाक्य | Adjective Clause (Relative)
क्रियाविशेषण उपवाक्य | Adverb Clause
प्रधान उपवाक्य | Principal Clause
questions.explanation: 'which is on the table' उपवाक्य 'The book' संज्ञा की विशेषता बता रहा है, इसलिए यह Adjective Clause है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्यों को जोड़ें: 'He did not work hard. He failed.'
options: He did not work hard but failed.
He failed so he did not work hard.
Although he failed, he did not work hard.
He failed because he did not work hard.
questions.explanation: कारण को स्पष्ट करने के लिए 'because' कंजंक्शन से वाक्यों को जोड़ा जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्यों को जोड़ें: 'He saw a tiger. He ran away.' (Using Participle)
options: Having seen a tiger he was running away.
Seeing a tiger, he ran away.
He saw a tiger and ran away.
He ran away to see a tiger.
questions.explanation: जब एक ही कर्ता द्वारा तुरंत एक के बाद दूसरा कार्य किया जाए, तो पहले कार्य को Present Participle (V4 - Seeing) में बदल देते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: क्लॉज़ की पहचान करें: 'If you work hard, you will pass.'
options: क्रियाविशेषण उपवाक्य | Adverb Clause of Condition
संज्ञा उपवाक्य | Noun Clause
विशेषण उपवाक्य | Adjective Clause
प्रधान उपवाक्य | Principal Clause
questions.explanation: 'If you work hard' शर्त को दर्शाने वाला क्रियाविशेषण उपवाक्य (Adverb Clause) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्यों को जोड़ें: 'She was ill. She attended the class.'
options: She attended the class because she was ill.
She was ill and attended the class.
She was ill so she attended the class.
Although she was ill, she attended the class.
questions.explanation: विरोधाभास को व्यक्त करने के लिए 'Although/Though... yet' या कोमा का प्रयोग कर वाक्यों को संयोजित किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'आपसे मिलकर बहुत खुशी हुई।'
options: Pleased to meet you. / Nice to meet you.
I happy you meet.
You meet is happy.
Meet you is happy.
questions.explanation: किसी से मिलने पर शिष्टाचार के लिए 'Nice to meet you' या 'Pleased to meet you' बोला जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'चिल्लाओ मत, बच्चे सो रहे हैं।'
options: No shouting, children were sleeping.
Don't shout, children sleep.
Don't shout, the children are sleeping.
Don't shout, the children is sleeping.
questions.explanation: आदेश सूचक निषेध (Don't shout) और वर्तमान में जारी क्रिया (are sleeping) का प्रयोग होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'आपकी घड़ी में कितने बजे हैं?'
options: How much time by your watch?
What is time in your watch?
What are time in watch?
What is the time by your watch?
questions.explanation: घड़ी के माध्यम से समय पूछने के लिए प्रीपोजीशन 'by' का प्रयोग होता है (by your watch)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: 'Let us have a cup of tea.'
options: हमें चाय पसंद है।
चाय पीना स्वास्थ्य के लिए हानिकारक है।
आओ हम सब एक कप चाय पीते हैं।
चाय टेबल पर रखी है।
questions.explanation: 'Let us have...' का अर्थ किसी कार्य का प्रस्ताव देना (आओ हम चाय पीते हैं) होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'धूम्रपान करना स्वास्थ्य के लिए हानिकारक है।'
options: Smoke is harmful to health.
Smoking is bad for health.
Smoking is injuring health.
Smoking is injurious to health.
questions.explanation: यह एक मानक वाक्य है जिसमें 'injurious' के साथ 'to' प्रीपोजीशन का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'वह बहुत मीठा गाती है।'
options: She sings very sweet.
She is singing very sweet.
She sings very sweetly.
She sing very sweetly.
questions.explanation: क्रिया (sings) की विशेषता बताने के लिए Adverb 'sweetly' का प्रयोग होगा, न कि Adjective 'sweet' का।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: 'Mind your own business.'
options: दिमाग शांत रखो।
अपने काम से काम रखो।
अपना व्यापार बढ़ाओ।
दूसरों की मदद करो।
questions.explanation: 'Mind your own business' का अर्थ किसी को फालतू हस्तक्षेप करने से रोकना (अपने काम से काम रखना) होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'कल रात मुझे बहुत गहरी नींद आई।'
options: I had a sound sleep last night.
I have slept well yesterday night.
I slept very hard yesterday night.
I was sound sleeping last night.
questions.explanation: गहरी और शांत नींद के लिए 'sound sleep' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'मेहनत कभी बेकार नहीं जाती।'
options: Hard work is not waste.
Hard work never goes waste.
Hard work was not wasted.
Working hard never wastes.
questions.explanation: यह एक सार्वभौमिक लोकोक्ति है, जिसका अंग्रेजी अनुवाद 'Hard work never goes waste' है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: 'Make yourself comfortable.'
options: अपने आप को ठीक करो।
कमरे को साफ करो।
आरामदायक सोफे पर बैठो।
आराम से बैठिए / इसे अपना ही घर समझिए।
questions.explanation: मेहमानों के स्वागत और उन्हें असहजता से बचाने के लिए 'Make yourself comfortable' बोला जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'truth / speak / must / at / costs / the / all / one'
options: At all costs the truth one must speak.
One must speak the truth at all costs.
One speak the truth must at all costs.
Speak the truth one must at all costs.
questions.explanation: सही व्याकरणिक ढांचा 'Subject + Modal + V1 + Object + Phrase' (One must speak the truth at all costs) होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: अफेर्मेटिव में बदलें: 'None but the brave deserve the fair.'
options: The brave always deserve the fair.
None deserve the fair but brave.
The brave only deserve the fair.
Only the brave deserve the fair.
questions.explanation: 'None but' का प्रयोग केवल 'Only' के स्थान पर नकारात्मक वाक्यों में किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: कंपरेटिव डिग्री में बदलें: 'Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist.'
options: Shakespeare is greater than other English dramatist.
Shakespeare is greater than any other English dramatist.
Shakespeare is as great as any other English dramatist.
Shakespeare is not greater than all English dramatists.
questions.explanation: सुपरलेटिव से कॉम्परेटिव में बदलने के लिए 'greater than any other + Singular Noun' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: साधारण वाक्य में बदलें: 'Exclamatory: Alas! That youth should pass away so soon!'
options: It is sad that youth should pass away so soon.
Alas! Youth is passing away.
Youth should not pass away so soon.
Is youth passing away so soon?
questions.explanation: 'Alas!' को साधारण वाक्य में बदलते समय 'It is sad/lamentable that...' संरचना का प्रयोग करते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: रिमूव 'Too' करें: 'The sun is too hot for us to go out.'
options: The sun is too hot that we cannot go out.
The sun is so hot that we cannot go out.
The sun is very hot that we cannot go out.
The sun is so hot for us that we cannot go out.
questions.explanation: जब 'too' के साथ 'for us' लगा हो, तो 'that' के बाद उपवाक्य का कर्ता 'we' हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'lost / is / time / lost / forever /'
options: Forever lost is lost time.
Time is lost forever lost.
Time lost is lost forever.
Lost time is forever lost.
questions.explanation: यह समय के महत्व पर एक प्रसिद्ध कहावत है: 'Time lost is lost forever' (खोया समय हमेशा के लिए खो जाता है)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव में बदलें: 'It is time to close the shop.'
options: It is time for the shop to be closed.
The shop should be closed now.
It is time that the shop is closed.
It was time to close the shop.
questions.explanation: 'It is time + to + V1 + Object' का पैसिव 'It is time + for + Object + to + be + V3' होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट में बदलें: He said to me, 'Good morning.'
options: He wished good morning to me.
He told me good morning.
He wished me good morning.
He said good morning to me.
questions.explanation: शुभकामनाओं वाले वाक्यों (जैसे Good morning) में 'said to' को 'wished' में बदल दिया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: अशुद्ध वाक्य को शुद्ध करें: 'He is as tall, if not taller than his brother.'
options: He is as tall, if not taller as his brother.
He is as tall as, if not taller than his brother.
He is tall as, if not taller than his brother.
He is as tall, as if not taller than his brother.
questions.explanation: जब तुलनात्मक वाक्यों में दोनों डिग्रियों का प्रयोग हो, तो प्रथम भाग 'as... as' पूरा होना चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'where / fire / is / smoke / there / is / a / there'
options: There is smoke where there is fire.
Smoke is there where fire is there.
Where there is smoke, there is fire.
Where fire is smoke is there.
questions.explanation: यह एक प्रसिद्ध कहावत है: 'Where there is smoke, there is fire' (जहाँ धुआँ है, वहाँ आग है)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'चिंता चिता के समान है।'
options: Anxiety is fire.
Anxiety is like a funeral pyre. / Worry kills.
Anxiety kills human.
Worry is death.
questions.explanation: यह एक प्रसिद्ध हिंदी कहावत है जिसका सटीक भावार्थ 'Anxiety is like a funeral pyre' या 'Worry kills' होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'health / wealth / is /'
options: Is health wealth.
Wealth is health.
Health is wealth.
Wealth health is.
questions.explanation: यह एक अत्यंत लोकप्रिय सुविचार है: 'Health is wealth' (स्वास्थ्य ही धन है)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: नकारात्मक में बदलें: 'Assertive: Only a rich man can buy this car.'
options: Only not a rich man can buy this car.
None but a rich man can buy this car.
A rich man cannot buy this car.
No rich man can buy this car.
questions.explanation: 'Only' को हटाने पर वाक्य के शुरू में 'None but' का प्रयोग कर अर्थ अक्षुण्ण रखा जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्यों को जोड़ें: 'He is rich. He is unhappy.'
options: He is rich yet he is unhappy.
He is rich so he is unhappy.
He is unhappy because he is rich.
He is rich because he is unhappy.
questions.explanation: अमीर होने के बावजूद दुखी होने के विरोधाभास को 'yet' या 'but' से दर्शाया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: रिमूव 'Too' करें: 'The news is too good to be true.'
options: The news is so good to be true.
The news is very good to be true.
The news is so good that it cannot be true.
The news is too good that it cannot be true.
questions.explanation: 'too... to' संरचना को 'so... that it cannot...' में बदला गया है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'तुमने कल क्या खाया?'
options: What did you eat yesterday?
What you ate yesterday?
What did you ate yesterday?
What have you eaten yesterday?
questions.explanation: भूतकाल के प्रश्नवाचक में 'What + did + Subject + V1' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए शब्दों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: 'crying / over / spilt / use / no / milk / is / there / it'
options: There is no spilt milk crying use over.
Spilt milk crying over is there no use.
There is no use crying over spilt milk.
Crying over spilt milk is there no use.
questions.explanation: यह एक प्रसिद्ध कहावत है: 'There is no use crying over spilt milk' (अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पॉजिटिव डिग्री में बदलें: 'Iron is more useful than any other metal.'
options: No other metal is as useful as iron.
No other metal is more useful than iron.
Iron is as useful as other metals.
Other metals are not useful like iron.
questions.explanation: सुपरलेटिव/कॉम्परेटिव से पॉजिटिव बनाने के लिए 'No other metal is as... as' सही प्रारूप है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही अनुवाद चुनें: 'सच्चा मित्र वही है जो समय पर काम आए।'
options: A friend is helpful.
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
A true friend comes on time.
A friend who helps is good.
questions.explanation: यह अंग्रेजी की बहुत प्रसिद्ध कहावत है: 'A friend in need is a friend indeed.'
questions.subject: English

questions.q: क्लॉज़ की पहचान करें: 'I believe that he is honest.'
options: संज्ञा उपवाक्य | Noun Clause
विशेषण उपवाक्य | Adjective Clause
प्रधान उपवाक्य | Principal Clause
क्रियाविशेषण उपवाक्य | Adverb Clause
questions.explanation: 'that he is honest' यहाँ 'believe' क्रिया के ऑब्जेक्ट (कर्म) के रूप में कार्य कर रहा है, अतः यह Noun Clause है।
questions.subject: English
